title: LevelDB / RocksDB table file signature
summary: A LevelDB (and RocksDB) SSTable file begins with a 48-byte (or 32-byte for legacy) footer. The last 8 bytes of the file are the magic number 0x57FB808B (little-endian) for LevelDB, or 0x88E241B6 for RocksDB.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Magic 0x57FB808B is at the END of the file (last 8 bytes), not the beginning.
The footer also contains metaindex and index block handles.
SSTables are immutable sorted string tables; compaction merges them.
